name: flutter-anti-stuck
description: Claude Code never waits forever on Flutter work: hard time limits on every Bash call, fail-fast Marionette MCP guards, a cross-session device/build ledger (devctl), and forced reporting when long or background work ends.

agent_limit_minutes.title: Subagent time limit (minutes)
agent_limit_minutes.description: After this many minutes every tool call inside a subagent is denied so it reports and stops.

require_foreground_agents.title: Require foreground subagents
require_foreground_agents.description: Deny Agent calls that do not set run_in_background: false, so results are always reported right away.

allow_background.title: Allow background Bash without asking
allow_background.description: When off, run_in_background Bash is only allowed if your last message asked for background work.

android_package.title: Android applicationId override
android_package.description: Leave empty to read applicationId from android/app/build.gradle(.kts) of the app devctl started.
